column1: # Generated by the wave-0 extractor over backend-mutation-checks.md, then hand-completed.
# wave: W1 = self-flagged by the queue (THE row / armed / the security row / worth running first)
#       GAP = the row says it cannot produce a measurement (retired per the 2026-08-22 decision,
#             UNLESS it also says "may redden nothing", in which case it is W1 and runs)
# wave: S = the scripted sweeps (run plan §6), derived 2026-08-23 in four stated families:
#       S-A gate-constant swaps — run plan §5's named id list (26 ids; 4 already run in wave 1)
#       S-B the mutated file is under backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/ (excludes the
#           Hetzner V20-V33 lane, GAP rows and the manual lane)
#       S-C the mutated file is a convention/ArchUnit/schema test, or a production constant
#           register whose only observer is one, AND the edit adds/removes a register entry,
#           corpus root or exclusion (not rule logic)
#       S-D enum declaration order, severity value, or severity rank
#       Derived count 74 against the plan's ~100 estimate; the manifest is authoritative.
# wave: 2 = the three cross-cutting fixture families (run plan §5's D1/D3/D8 tables), derived
#       2026-08-23 as the union of three published id lists plus the rows wave 1 held as BLIND:
#       D1 the dropped `AND x.project_id = :projectId` predicate over RLS (12 ids)
#       D8 an ORDER BY that loses its id tiebreak (9 ids)
#       D3 an ON CONFLICT set-list on case_health clobbering a sibling writer's columns (8 ids)
#       + 13k, held BLIND by wave 1 for the same two-instant fixture D8 needs
#       Derived count 30 against the run plan's "~10 rows + 3 tests"; the manifest is authoritative.
#       The plan's ~10 is its COLLAPSE (keep 2 + 3 + 3), not the family membership. A row carrying
#       W1+2 was already measured in wave 1 and is re-measured here against the new fixture.
# wave: W3 = the slimmed wave 3, derived 2026-08-23 in docs/plans/2026-08-23-wave-3-slimmed.md.
#       113 of the 509 rows wave 3 would have held, admitted on the ROW's own text by one of:
#       gap (the row predicts GREEN / names itself a known gap — 41; the class waves 1+2
#           withdrew ten of and confirmed seven, the highest surprise rate in the pass)
#       blind ("the only observer" / "confirm whether" / "check when running" / "no observer" — 38)
#       sec (cross-company, RLS, a permission gate, a cap bypass — 16)
#       loss (silent destruction: a clobbered column, an overwritten draft, bytes before the row — 15)
#       probe (two rows from each section that already produced a ZERO-UNEXPECTED or FEWER and
#       D2/D4/D5/D6/D9 (the run plan §5 collapse representatives wave 2 did not reach — 8)
#       The 396 rows NOT admitted keep their ids and their `queued` status with no wave tag. That is
#       a recorded deferral, not a truncation: wave 3b can be derived from them the same way.
# CLOSED:NOT-RUN — 492 rows, set 2026-08-23 at the user's direction: the pass ends here and no
#       further mutation time is spent on this file. It means CLOSED WITHOUT MEASUREMENT and
#       NOTHING ELSE. It is not a zero, not a green, and not evidence that the test named in the
#       row observes anything. A reader asking "is this behaviour covered?" gets NO ANSWER from a
#       CLOSED row — the honest reading is "nobody looked", which is the same state the row was in
#       before this pass began, minus the intention to look. The rows keep their ids, their text
#       and their derived scopes, so re-opening the set is a status edit and nothing more.
# scope is the test class named IN the row, else the first named in its section prose; ? = derive it
# file is filled in when the row is run — it is the exact path the revert uses
